subject: SeedSpace activation & invite map: API keys, roles, and kickoff
messages:
From: SeedSpace Onboarding <onboarding@seedspace.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ari Kaplan <ari@seedspace.io>, Rachel Timmons <rachel@seedspace.io>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation timeline + initial info for Redwood

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We're excited to move forward with Redwood for inference on our content tagging pipeline. Quick primer on the environment: 

- SeedSpace wants a single production tenant with separate projects for staging and prod.
- We need at least two admin users and four dev seats.
- Security requires that API keys be rotated monthly and that RBAC map to our internal roles (engineer, infra, analyst).

Could you send a short checklist of the items we need to complete (key seeding, roles matrix, Drive link to docs), and propose a 30–45 minute kickoff time early next week? Prefer morning PT.

Appreciate it — Ari

--
Ari Kaplan
CTO, SeedSpace
ari@seedspace.io
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: SeedSpace Onboarding <onboarding@seedspace.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation timeline + initial info for Redwood

Hi Ari / Rachel —

Thanks — excited to get SeedSpace live. Below is a compact onboarding checklist and proposed plan we can run in the kickoff. Ben and Dev are looped in for keying and invite orchestration.

Onboarding checklist (initial tenant + access):
1) Confirm tenant name and primary billing contact.
2) Create 2 admin users + 4 developer seats; send invite cadence.
3) Create staging and prod projects (names and quotas).
4) Seed API keys for a service account (short-lived staging key + production key in KMS).
5) Configure RBAC mapping file (engineer / infra / analyst) and link to SeedSpace SSO group names.
6) Set up key rotation policy (monthly) and enable audit logs to your SIEM endpoint.
7) Share sandbox prompts for quality smoke tests and monitoring hooks.

Kickoff slots (PT): Mon Jul 3 09:30–10:00, Mon Jul 3 11:00–11:45, Tue Jul 4 08:30–09:15. Please confirm what works.

I'll attach an onboarding map and a short key rotation guide (see attachments). In the kickoff we'll: walk the invites/API-key steps (Ben), map RBAC to your groups (Dev), and agree on test/rollout dates.

Cheers,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@seedspace.io>, SeedSpace Onboarding <onboarding@seedspace.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Jul 2028 08:52:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation timeline + initial info for Redwood

On Mon, Jun 30, 2028 at 11:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Ari / Rachel —
> 
> Thanks — excited to get SeedSpace live. Below is a compact onboarding checklist and proposed plan we can run in the kickoff. Ben and Dev are looped in for keying and invite orchestration.

Quick notes from my side so the engineering team has everything for seeding: 

- Required inputs from SeedSpace before I seed keys: tenant display name, intended project IDs for staging/prod (avoid special characters), and billing contact email.
- I will create a dedicated service account called seedspace-svc@redwood and generate one short-lived staging key (30d) and one production key (KMS-wrapped).
- We'll provide an env var snippet and a curl example for token exchange in the attachment.
- For SSO/RBAC, share the exact group names (e.g. seedspace-engineers, seedspace-infra) and we will map to internal roles.

Attachments: seedspace-onboard-map.pdf (detailed runbook), redwood-api-key-rotation-guide.pdf (how rotation/rollover works).

Ari — does Tue Jul 4 08:30 PT work for the kickoff? If so I'll send a calendar invite and pre-create the staging project so you can validate keys during the call.

Ben
Senior Onboarding Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Kaplan <ari@seedspace.io>, SeedSpace Onboarding <onboarding@seedspace.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Activation timeline + initial info for Redwood

On Mon, Jul 3, 2028 at 08:52 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick notes from my side so the engineering team has everything for seeding: 

Thanks everyone — confirming the kickoff for Tue Jul 4 08:30 PT. Invite sent.

Ari / Rachel — to make the call efficient please reply with the three items below before EOD tomorrow so I can pre-provision: 
- Tenant display name (exact string we should create in the control plane)
- Project IDs for staging and prod (suggested: seedspace-staging, seedspace-prod)
- Primary billing contact email

I'll pre-create the staging project and a placeholder service account so Ben can generate the staging key during the call. After the call I'll post the invite links and steps in the shared Drive folder.

If you have any compliance constraints (IP allowlists, firewall rules, SIEM endpoints) send those now so we can add them to the runbook.

Cheers,
Dev Patel
Platform Onboarding | Redwood Inference
